text: My 2 year old has a temp of 39.6 tonight. I think it's mostly teeth honestly, he's drooling everywhere, gnawing on anything he can get hold of and one cheek is bright red. Bit of a cough too but nothing much. He's breathing fine, and his colour's normal, lips and skin all look like usual. I've not given anything yet as I wasn't sure about doses with the fever being that high. Probably fine to just do calpol and keep an eye on him, but thought I'd check.
